main_text.p: אֶחְיֶה vivam, fut. Kal, אֶחְיֶה in vita conserva-bo, fut. Piel, 1. sing. Rad. חָיָה.
אֲחִישָׁנָּה accelerabo, אֲחִישֶׁנָּה accelerabo illud, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. parag. & aff. Rad. חוּשׁ.
אָחֵל, אָחֵל incipiam, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. Rad. חָלַל.
וַאֲחַל & profanor, 1. sing. fut. Niph. R. חָלַל.
וַאֲחַלְלֶךָּ & profanabo te, fut. Piel, 1. sing. affix. Rad. חָלַל.
אָחֵן gratiam faciam, 1. sing. fut. Kal, Rad. חָנַן.
אֲחַכְמָה sapiens ero, 1. sing. fut. Kal, R. חָכַם.
אַחְלָמָה amethystus, No. sing. fæm. R. חָלַם somniare.
אַחַר distulit, præt. Piel, 3. sing. m. וַיְאַחֵר & moratus sum, 1. sing. fut. Kal, Rad. אָחַר.
אַחֲרוֹן posterior, אַחֲרִית posteriorit...
אַחֲרִית posteritas, extremitas, &c. No. sing. maf. & fæm. Rad. אַחַר post, postea.
אַחֵרִין alii, No. pl. m. à sing. m. אַחַר alius, alter, Rad. אַחַר post, postea.
אַחֲרוּ differunt, Jud. 5.28. præt. Pih. 3. pl. Rad. אָחַר.
אֲחַשֵּׁךְ cohibebo, 1. sing. fut. Kal, R. חָשַׁךְ.
אַחַת אַחַת una, pro אַחַת No. sing. fæm. Rad. אֶחָד unus.
אֶחְתָּה terrebor, 1. sing. fut. Niph. paragog. Rad. חָתַת.
אַחְתְּךָ conteram te, 1. singul. futur, Hiph. affix. Rad. חָתַת.
וַאֲחַתָּם & obsignavi, 1. f. fut. Kal, R. חָתַם.
וַאֲחַתֹּר & fodi, 1. sing. fut. Kal, R. חָתַר.
אט sensim, lente, לְאַטִּי ad lenitatem meam, Part. præf.

page.notes: Hebrew words are transcribed approximately from the scan; the vowel points and some Hebrew letters are small and doubtful and may not be exact. Lines in the left column near "posteriorit..." and the Hebrew forms at the start of several entries are uncertain. The Hebrew headword "אֲחַרוֹן" line is partly cut at the column break and marked as doubtful. Where the scan is blurred, Hebrew forms are reconstructed from the Latin glosses and may contain errors. The first Hebrew word of the right column's "אֲחַרִין" and the "אַחַת" headword are doubtful.
